timestamp_methodology.limitation: One source row is treated as one proxy second; nominal 10-second windows do not prove wall-clock time-to-attack forecasting.

split_methodology.train: first 90% of each session's initial 85% development block
split_methodology.validation: last 10% of each session's initial 85% development block; checkpoint selection set
split_methodology.test: final 15% of every session; strict chronological holdout

session_boundary_leakage.detail: Sequences were rebuilt independently per capture session and contiguous block.

future_feature_leakage.detail: Every target window ID is exactly one after the final input window ID.

synthetic_session_continuity.detail: Proxy window IDs restart per source file; sequence construction is session-scoped.
